source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the News-Letter's nomination list of 8 May 1924

note: Nomination-day report for the fourteen single-member divisions of Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district. Six Unionist candidates were returned unopposed; in the remaining eight divisions no nominations were received. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
